# User Management

> Invite team members, assign roles, and manage access to your Zencoder organization.

User Management lets admins invite team members, assign roles, and control access across the organization.

## Inviting Users

Click the **Invite** button to add a new team member. Enter their email address and select a role:

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/forgoodaiinc/Y_SEC3iavYl5Qnon/images/admin/admin-invite-user.jpg?fit=max&auto=format&n=Y_SEC3iavYl5Qnon&q=85&s=22c24f096c79deb582958173d2e041ed" alt="Invite user dialog showing email address field and role selector with Member, Admin, and Manager options" style={{ borderRadius: '12px', marginTop: '8px', marginBottom: '16px' }} width="1260" height="720" data-path="images/admin/admin-invite-user.jpg" />

An invitation email is sent with a link to complete account setup.

## Roles

| Role | Permissions |
| - | - |
| **Member** | Use agents, create tasks, access assigned repositories. Cannot manage billing or organization settings. |
| **Admin** | Full access to all organization settings, billing, user management, SSO, and API keys. |
| **Manager** | Manage users and quotas. Cannot modify billing or SSO settings. |

## User List

The user table shows all organization members with:

* **Name and email** — User identity
* **Role** — Current role assignment
* **Status** — Active, Invited, or Deactivated
* **Last active** — When the user was last active on the platform

Use the search bar to find users by name or email. Filter by role using the dropdown.
